components: Orchestration: commits the next local step
links: report control data to Workflow coordinator

steps: The orchestrator durably records the workflow and sends a command to A.
A executes idempotently and returns a correlated result.
The orchestrator advances state and commands B or chooses compensation.
After failure, it reloads state and resumes the exact pending transition.

lesson.scenario: A passport renewal coordinator orders photo review, fee capture, printing, and recovery.

steps.title: Persist the workflow
steps.narration: The coordinator stores APP-73 and its first command before dispatch.
steps.outcome: A crash cannot lose which command must run next.
steps.invariant: Workflow state and command identity are durable before delivery.

steps.title: Accept the portrait
steps.narration: Photo review handles a correlated command and returns PhotoAccepted.
steps.outcome: The coordinator makes the global next step explicit.
steps.invariant: Replies advance only the matching application and command.

steps.title: Capture the renewal fee
steps.narration: The fee ledger captures exactly $130 under stable charge ID CH-73.
steps.outcome: Payment success is recorded before printing is commanded.
steps.invariant: Command handlers are idempotent under their stable business IDs.

steps.title: Recover a printing timeout
steps.narration: No reply arrives, so the coordinator reloads PRINT_PENDING and retries B-73.
steps.outcome: Recovery resumes the pending transition instead of restarting the renewal.
steps.invariant: A timeout means outcome unknown, not operation failed.

steps.title: Complete once
steps.narration: The printer returns BookletPrinted; a duplicate reply cannot advance APP-73 again.
steps.outcome: APP-73 finishes with one fee and one booklet.
steps.invariant: Terminal workflow state is durable and duplicate replies are harmless.
